title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support setInputStream XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the setInputStream method. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose files in the context of SYSTEM.
